speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I need to understand your skin lesion to evaluate it properly. Can you describe the lesion's appearance, including its size, shape, and any changes over time, such as itching, bleeding, or growth?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (penile and digital).

Your history of heavy smoking, non-healing crusty lesions on both the penis and finger, and failure of previous treatments are highly concerning for malignancy. We need to confirm this immediately with a biopsy. REQUEST TEST: Biopsy of penile lesion and left middle finger lesion. REQUEST IMAGES: Penile lesion, Left middle finger lesion.
